blocks.text: Gas transport (gases ka ek jagah se doosri jagah le jaya jana) respiration ka zaroori hissa hai. Oxygen lungs se jism ke tamam tissues tak jati hai aur usi waqt carbon dioxide tissues se lungs tak aati hai. Neeche bataya gaya hai ke insaan ke jism mein gases kaise le jayi jati hain.
